mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLAN ( MEMBER_NO, PLAN_NAME, X_AXIS, Y_AXIS ) VALUES ( #{memberNo}, #{planName}, #{xAxis}, #{yAxis} )
mapper.select: SELECT PLAN_NO, MEMBER_NO, PLAN_NAME, X_AXIS, Y_AXIS, CREATE_DATE FROM PLAN WHERE PLAN_NO = #{planNo}

SELECT P.PLAN_NO, P.MEMBER_NO, P.PLAN_NAME, P.X_AXIS, P.Y_AXIS, P.CREATE_DATE, COUNT(PS.PLACE_NO) AS PLACE_COUNT FROM PLAN P LEFT JOIN PLAN_SESSION PS ON P.PLAN_NO = PS.PLAN_NO WHERE P.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} GROUP BY P.PLAN_NO, P.MEMBER_NO, P.PLAN_NAME, P.X_AXIS, P.Y_AXIS, P.CREATE_DATE ORDER BY P.CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT PS.PLACE_NO, PS.PLACE_ORDER, P.PLACE_NAME, P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION, P.ADDR, P.ADDR_DETAIL, P.X_AXIS, P.Y_AXIS, T.TYPE_NO, P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO, PI.IMG_NO, PI.IMG_PATH FROM PLAN_SESSION PS JOIN PLACE P ON PS.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO LEFT JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO LEFT JOIN TYPE T ON TD.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PLACE_NO, IMG_NO, IMG_PATH FROM ( SELECT PLACE_NO, IMG_NO, IMG_PATH, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PLACE_NO ORDER BY IMG_ORDER, IMG_NO) AS RN FROM PLACE_IMG WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) PI ON P.PLACE_NO = PI.PLACE_NO WHERE PS.PLAN_NO = #{planNo} ORDER BY PS.PLACE_ORDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLAN_SESSION ( PLAN_NO, PLACE_NO, PLACE_ORDER ) VALUES ( #{planNo}, #{placeNo}, #{placeOrder} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.PLACE_NO ,P.PLACE_NAME ,P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION ,P.X_AXIS ,P.Y_AXIS ,P.ADDR ,P.ADDR_DETAIL ,6371000 * 2 * ASIN( SQRT( POWER( SIN( (P.Y_AXIS - #{yAxis}) * 3.141592653589793 / 180 / 2 ), 2 ) + COS(#{yAxis} * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * COS(P.Y_AXIS * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * POWER( SIN( (P.X_AXIS - #{xAxis}) * 3.141592653589793 / 180 / 2 ), 2 ) ) ) AS DISTANCE ,T.TYPE_NO ,TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO ,PI.IMG_NO ,PI.IMG_PATH FROM PLACE P LEFT JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO LEFT JOIN TYPE T ON TD.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PLACE_NO, IMG_NO, IMG_PATH FROM ( SELECT PLACE_NO ,IMG_NO ,IMG_PATH ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY PLACE_NO ORDER BY IMG_NO ) AS RN FROM PLACE_IMG ) WHERE RN = 1 ) PI ON P.PLACE_NO = PI.PLACE_NO ) WHERE DISTANCE <= CASE TYPE_NO WHEN 1 THEN 10000 WHEN 2 THEN 2000 WHEN 3 THEN 8000 WHEN 4 THEN 2000 WHEN 5 THEN 10000 WHEN 6 THEN 3000 WHEN 7 THEN 8000 WHEN 8 THEN 5000 WHEN 9 THEN 8000 WHEN 10 THEN 2000 WHEN 11 THEN 3000 ELSE 3000 END
